projectDescription: A desktop application for technical writers to automatically evaluate the completeness and quality of instructions in technical documentation using LLM-powered analysis.
keyFeatures: Upload and parse documents in PDF, DOCX, Markdown, and TXT formats
Load and evaluate web pages by URL using a headless browser
Automatic detection of instruction sections using morphological analysis
LLM-powered evaluation against configurable quality criteria
Project-based organization with auto-generated product context for improved accuracy
Snapshot system for saving and comparing evaluation results across document versions
Manage LLM models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama) and criteria sets through the UI
Mark false positives to refine evaluation results
Runs entirely locally — all data stored in SQLite on the user's machine
publicApiSurface: GET /api/documents/{id}/structure — get document section tree with evaluation results
GET /api/evaluation/document/{id} — evaluate entire document via SSE stream
PATCH /api/projects/{id} — rename or update project context
POST /api/projects/{id}/generate-context — generate product context via LLM
PATCH /api/projects/documents/{id}/assign — move document to a project
POST /api/web/load — load a web page by URL
